name: Master of the Suplex

start.dialog: You look like you've got potential! But you're not using your body right! A true martial artist can suplex ANYTHING! Train with me - catch a runaway sand cruiser with a suplex! What do you say?
start.objective: Learn Sabin's technique and suplex a runaway sand cruiser

progress.dialog: The timing is everything! Wait for it to charge, then GRAB and THROW! Channel your energy!
progress.objective: Practice the suplex timing on smaller targets first

complete.dialog: HA! DID YOU SEE THAT?! SUPLEXED A CRUISER! You're a natural! Here - my brother's belt. He was a king, you know. This has seen many battles. Now it's yours!

party_comments.kade: He... he just suplexed a VEHICLE.
party_comments.grit: Using enemy momentum against them. Classic technique.

hidden_outcome: If you suplex the cruiser into another enemy, Sabin teaches you 'Meteor Strike' - a devastating aerial piledriver
